chunks: Abu Ja‘far al-Baqir (عليه السلام) said concerning the siwak:
"Do not neglect it for three days; even if only by passing it once."

key_terms.السِّوَاكِ: the tooth-stick used for cleaning the teeth
key_terms.تُمِرَّهُ: pass it over, meaning use the siwak
key_terms.لَا تَدَعْهُ: do not leave it or neglect it

ai.seo_question: How often should the siwak be used according to Imam al-Baqir (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (عليه السلام) instructs that the siwak should not be abandoned for as long as three days. Even minimal use of it once is encouraged, showing the importance of maintaining this practice regularly.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.119 - Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said about the siwak:
"Do not neglect it for more than three days, even if you use it just once."
